key_finding_june5.diagnosis: Routing problem, not a knowledge problem
key_finding_june5.detail: Stefan has 2,500+ pieces of content across 5 separate systems (Google Drive, Apple Notes, Mac filesystem, Obsidian vaults, Downloads) with zero integration between them. The raw material — Vision (419KB), BELIEFS (148KB), Chase Hughes notes (198KB), Master Doc (212KB) — exists and is high quality. The gap is routing it to the right place so it becomes usable.
